title: Lockport High School sees 138 multiracial students, comprising 10.3% of 2025-26 enrollment
text:
Lockport High School had 138 multiracial students in the 2025-26 school year, representing a 5.3% increase from the prior year, the New York State Education Department reported.
The school’s data indicates a total enrollment of 1,339 during 2025-26. Multiracial students accounted for 10.3% of the student body, making them the third largest ethnic group there.
The campus is part of the Lockport City School District, headquartered in Lockport.
Lockport High School had the largest multiracial student enrollment among the district’s seven schools at that time.
New York ranks second in the country for K-12 public education spending , with current expenditures per student averaging $30,012. That figure is almost twice the national average of $16,526, according to the Education Data Initiative.
